stem_book: In the conversion of limestone to lime: CaCO₃(s) → CaO(s) + CO₂(g). The values of ΔH° and ΔS° are 179.1 kJ mol⁻¹ and 160.2 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ respectively at 298 K and 1 bar. Assuming ΔH° and ΔS° remain constant with temperature, above which temperature will the conversion of limestone to lime be spontaneous? (a) 1118 K (b) 1008 K (c) 1200 K (d) 845 K
reason: Printed 'at which temperature … spontaneous' also fits 1200 K (ΔG < 0 there); reworded to 'above which temperature' so only the threshold (a) answers.
work: ΔG = 0 ⇒ T = ΔH/ΔS = 179100/160.2 = 1118 K; spontaneous for T > 1118 K
